advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Check the returncode of the sandboxed diagnostic `mutmut run` in _diagnose_non_killed and raise/surface on failure rather than parsing rerun results unconditionally.
evidence: scripts/mutation_gate.py:673-682 `_run(mutation_sandbox.wrap(...), cwd=root, env=env)` — result is not assigned or checked
Contrast execute_shard which checks `if mutation.returncode:` and raises GateError (scripts/mutation_gate.py:604-605, 619-622)

The verdict is derived purely from `after = parse_results(rerun.stdout)` (line 687-689); if the wrapped run never executed, `after` may be empty/unchanged and the function reports 'stable', masking a failed diagnostic — a fail-open check whose failure is invisible
advisory.finding: In _diagnose_non_killed the newly-sandboxed `mutmut run` subprocess return value is discarded — its returncode is never inspected before the diagnostic parses `rerun` results and returns a 'stable'/'nondeterminism' verdict, so a child that failed to launch, was denied by the sandbox, or crashed is indistinguishable from a successful re-run.
scenarios: Sandbox denies or fails to launch the diagnostic re-run and mutmut exits non-zero
mutmut run itself errors on the survivor set

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add an assertion binding _diagnose_non_killed's `allow=` argument to `(root, basetemp)` — either an AST binding test on the `allow=` keyword, or drive _diagnose_non_killed (or a factored allow-list helper) end-to-end so the production allow-list, not a re-derived copy, is exercised.
evidence: tests/scripts/test_mutation_sandbox.py:229-234: the @live test builds `argv = sb.wrap([...], allow=(root, basetemp), ...)` from its own locals, never calling _diagnose_non_killed
tests/scripts/test_mutation_sandbox.py:785-796: test_every_mutmut_run_in_the_module_is_sandbox_wrapped inspects only `_is_sandbox_wrapped(call)` (wrapper presence), never the `allow=` argument

ABSENCE rationale: named violating input — changing the production `sandbox_allow` at :671 to `(root, basetemp, root.parent)` widens the writable set to the parent of the repo yet no assertion inspects the allow-list, so the suite stays green
advisory.finding: The allow-list argument that _diagnose_non_killed passes to mutation_sandbox.wrap (`sandbox_allow = (root, basetemp)`, added at mutation_gate.py:671, applied at :676) is asserted by no test. The two module-wide binding tests check only wrapper presence and the env kwarg; the @live enforcement test hardcodes its own `allow=(root, basetemp)` and calls sb.wrap directly instead of driving _diagnose_non_killed, so it re-derives the allow-list rather than verifying the production one. Widening the production allow-list (e.g. to `(root, basetemp, root.parent)`) would leave every test green while re-opening the exact write path the sandbox exists to close.
advisory.suggested_fix: Extend test_every_mutmut_run_in_the_module_* (or add a sibling) to assert each `mutmut run` _run call passes `allow=` equal to the enclosing function's constructed `(root, basetemp)` tuple, and/or have the @live test call the production code path that builds the allow-list rather than reconstructing it inline.
